SRE.WrongSystem: Shadowrun Edge only works with the {system} system.

Wizard.Title: Item Wizard
Wizard.PresetGMOnly: Only the GM can save presets.
Wizard.PresetNeedsName: Enter a name to save the preset.
Wizard.PasteHint: Copy a row from a rulebook table (the name and its columns in order) and click Parse. The wizard reads DV (3P/2S), modes (SA/BF), AR (10/9/6/—/—), ammo 15(c), availability 2(L), cost 750¥ and "Rating × …" formulas.
Wizard.Name: Name
Wizard.RatingHint: Fields with "R" (e.g. R*0.1, R*1000) are calculated from the Rating.
Wizard.ARHint: Five ranges: close, near, medium, far, extreme. Empty = none (—).
Wizard.BulkHint: You can paste a whole table, one row per line, and create all items at once.

Mods.Title: Built-in mods
Mods.Empty: Drop a mod here (e.g. silencer, scope, armor modification) from a compendium or the Items directory.
Mods.Hint: When the item is dragged onto a character, the mods are installed automatically and their effects apply right away.
Mods.OnlyMods: Only mods (type "mod") can be dropped here.
Mods.Missing: Some mods were not found and were skipped.

Effect.Title: Mod effects
Effect.Hint: A mod changes the item it is installed in. The value may depend on the Rating, e.g. R or +2.
Effect.Label: Effect name (e.g. Bipod deployed)
Effect.ToggleHint: The effect starts disabled and is switched on on the item sheet when it applies (e.g. only against fire).
Effect.ActorHint: The augmentation changes the character carrying it. A value of "R" follows the item Rating. A "toggled" effect (e.g. adrenaline pump) is switched on on the item sheet.

Catalog.Label: Custom catalog (world)
Catalog.GMOnly: Only the GM can add items to the catalog.
Catalog.Locked: The compendium "{name}" is locked; unlock it to add items.
Catalog.BuiltInModsHint: They are installed when you drag this item onto a character.

Grade.Title: Implant grade: {name}
Grade.Hint: Rulebook grades (p. 282) change Essence, cost and Availability. The grade can be changed later with the button in the item sheet header.

Setting.Name: Ask for implant grade
Setting.Hint: When cyberware or bioware is dropped on a character, ask for its grade (used, alpha, beta, delta).

Mount.Label: Mount (weapon)
Mount.CapacityCostHint: Capacity it takes up in armor or a device, e.g. 2, or R (= Rating).

Error.mountTaken: The mount ({mounts}) on {item} is taken; uninstall that accessory to install "{mod}".

Setting.Name: Mount and Capacity rules
Setting.Hint: What to do when a mod has no free mount or exceeds the item's Capacity.

Purchase.Title: Purchase: {name}
Purchase.Hint: "Free": starting or found gear. "Don't add" removes the item from the inventory.
Purchase.Licensed: (L) Needs a license attached to a SIN.

Size.dwarf: Dwarf: +10% on fitted gear, armor and clothing (p. 246).

Purchase.NotEnough: Not enough nuyen: the purchase costs {total}¥, the character has {nuyen}¥. The item stays in the inventory unpaid.

Setting.Name: Ask to purchase
Setting.Hint: When an item with a price is dropped on a player character, offer to buy it with the character's nuyen.

KarmaVote.Title: Karma vote
KarmaVote.NoSelf: Players do not vote for their own character
KarmaVote.Hint: Click how much Karma you suggest for each character (0–{max}). You can change your vote until it closes.
KarmaVote.HintNoSelf: Click how much Karma you suggest for each character (0–{max}) except your own. You can change your vote until it closes.
KarmaVote.AwardHint: The suggested value is the rounded average vote. You can change it before awarding.
KarmaVote.NoCharacters: No player characters (type "Player" owned by a player).
KarmaVote.NoGM: Votes go to the GM; wait until a GM is logged in.

Chargen.Title: Character creator
Chargen.Name: Name / handle
Chargen.ConceptHint: e.g. ork street samurai from Puyallup
Chargen.PriorityHint: Pick each row A–E once (pp. 63–64). Metatype shows adjustment points in brackets.

MagicNote.mystic: Mystic adept: powers for up to {magic} Magic, the remaining Magic × 2 are spells.

Chargen.AttributeHint: Every attribute starts at 1. Attribute points: physical and mental attributes. Adjustment points: Edge, Magic/Resonance and racial attributes (above 6). "+Karma": further ranks at 5 × new rank. Only one attribute may be at its maximum.
Chargen.SkillHint: Max 6 (7 with Aptitude), only one skill at the maximum. A specialization costs 1 skill point or 5 Karma (tick "with Karma"); at most one per skill.
Chargen.QualityHint: At most 6 qualities (racial ones aside), and negative qualities may give at most 20 Karma more than the positive ones cost (p. 66).
Chargen.VariableKarma: Karma for this quality (e.g. allergy: 20 − allergen − severity)
Chargen.KarmaToNuyenDebt: In Debt: 1 Karma = 5,000¥ and 5,000¥ of debt (p. 77).
Chargen.ContactHint: Charisma × 6 points for Connection and Loyalty, no rating above Charisma (p. 67).
Chargen.KnowledgeHint: Free: as many knowledge and language skills as Logic, plus one native language. Each further one costs 3 Karma.
Chargen.SummaryHint: After creating the character, buy gear by dragging catalog items onto the sheet (the purchase dialog takes the nuyen). At most 5,000¥ may be kept for play; spend the rest (a Lifestyle too).
Chargen.FixErrors: Fix the errors before creating the character.

Error.PriorityMissing: Pick a priority in every column.
Error.PriorityTwice: Each row A–E can be used only once.
Error.MetatypeRow: This metatype is not available in row {row}.
Error.MagicRow: This magic type is not available in row {row}.
Error.AdjustNotAllowed: Adjustment points cannot be spent on {attribute}.
Error.AttrTwoAtMax: Only one attribute may be at its maximum.
Error.SkillTwoAtMax: Only one skill may be at its maximum.
Error.SpecWithoutSkill: {skill}: a specialization needs at least 1 rank.
Error.QualitiesNet: Negative qualities give {net} net Karma; at most 20.

Chargen.Repaired: Shadowrun Edge: repaired {count} character(s) from the creator (missing attribute and skill modifiers caused 0d6 rolls).

Setting.Name: “Edge” system look
Setting.Hint: Dark or light module-styled look for character sheets, chat and roll dialogs. “Off” keeps the system's original look.

Override.Name: “Edge” look for everyone
Override.Hint: The GM can force one look for all players. “Player's choice” lets everyone pick their own.

Sheet.Label: Edge sheet (Shadowrun Edge)

Warn.wound: Wound penalty −{wound} is included in the pools shown (except damage resistance); the roll dialog applies it itself.
Warn.essence: Essence below 1 — another implant may kill the character.
Warn.edgeCap: Edge above 7 — more than the rules allow.

Sheet.NothingInHand: No weapons or spells — add them from the catalog or on the system sheet.
Sheet.Soon: This tab arrives in later module versions. Until then edit this data on the system sheet — both sheets share the same data.
Sheet.ModHint: Modifier from augmentations, qualities and effects (computed by the system)
Sheet.KnowledgeHint: SR6: knowledge skills have no rating — the character simply knows them.
Sheet.Name: Name
Sheet.ArRanges: AR: close / near / medium / far / extreme
Sheet.NoWeapons: No ranged weapons — drag one from the catalog.
Sheet.ArmorHint: The system computes Defense Rating: BOD + worn armor.
